newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: LITHUANIA-KLAIPEDOS NAFTA IN 16 MLN LITAS H1 PROFIT.
newsitem.headline: LITHUANIA-KLAIPEDOS NAFTA IN 16 MLN LITAS H1 PROFIT.

text.p: Lithuania's Klaipedos Nafta oil terminal said on Thursday that its profit for the first half of 1997 was 16 million litas and its turnover from handling oil products was 30 million litas.

"We can not provide comparative figures for the same period last year because Klaipedos Nafta started to run the oil terminal from January 1, 1997," the spokesman for the comapny, Eugenijus Vilunas, told Reuters.
Vilunas also said that the whole profit will be used to repay the credits for foreign banks taken to finance the reconstruction work of the terminal.
Reconstruction work worth $120 million is being carried out, Vilunas said.
The company said it handled 1.421 million tonnes of oil products and fertilisers in the first six months of the year, of which 65,000 tonnes was fertiliser and 75,000 tonnes was diesel fuel.
